items.title: Blackstone president calls for more equity to fund AI buildout as debt risks mount

items.title: Australia hikes rates to 18-year high to fight inflation
items.summary: Australia's central bank raised its benchmark cash rate by 25 basis points to 4.85% on Tuesday, the highest level since November 2008.
